title: Target environment
summary: A case's target_envs names registered environments; [] keeps the plan default. Verify on production by default: a case naming an environment without role.production true (stage) must declare stage_reason creates_or_destroys_data or changes_infrastructure, or authoring refuses stage_reason_required and teaches retargeting production. Each stage-targeted case enrolls its item on the stage run, so read-only checks stay on production. A control plane whose own environment declares qa.restrict_execution_to_self (Yoke's hosted Stage and Production) runs only cases that target that environment; there a standalone plan run targeting another environment refuses with cannot execute QA target and teaches running from the target's control plane or a deployment QA stage that targets it.
